title: Best Mobile App Marketing Experts (2026): How to Hire One
description: How to hire an app marketing expert: app store optimization, ads and launch plans, what to include, price factors and red flags.
intro: App marketing helps people find, install and keep using your app. It covers app store optimization (ASO), ads, launch plans and messages that bring users back. It goes wrong when services sell fake installs or reviews, when ads bring users who uninstall immediately, or when nobody measures what happens after the install. This guide helps you hire for real, lasting users.

faq.a: ASO improves your app store listing, including title, subtitle, keywords, screenshots, preview video and description, so more people find and install your app from store search and browsing.

faq.q: Can I buy installs or reviews?
faq.a: Buying fake installs or reviews breaks app store rules and can get your app removed. Legitimate campaigns use ads and outreach that reach real users.
Not just installs. Look at how many users stay after a day, a week and a month, and how many take key actions. Keeping users is usually harder than getting them.
Not always. ASO, content and word of mouth can work for some apps. Ads can speed up growth if you can track and afford them.

faq.q: What access will the marketer need?
faq.a: Access to your store accounts through team roles, analytics and ad accounts. Keep all accounts in your name.
